question: For the client whose credit card was issued on '1996-10-21', calculate the percentage increase in their account balance from their first transaction after card issuance to their latest transaction on or before December 27, 1998.

prediction.sql:
WITH target_account AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_015 AS account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_006 = d.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_008 = '1996-10-21'
),
relevant_trans AS (
    SELECT t.XCL_048 AS trans_date, t.XCL_052 AS balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_account ta ON t.XCL_047 = ta.account_id
    WHERE t.XCL_048 > '1996-10-21'
      AND t.XCL_048 <= '1998-12-27'
),
first_trans AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM relevant_trans
    ORDER BY trans_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
last_trans AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM relevant_trans
    ORDER BY trans_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST((lt.balance - ft.balance) AS REAL) * 100 / ft.balance
FROM first_trans ft
CROSS JOIN last_trans lt

WITH target_account AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_015 AS account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_006 = d.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_008 = '1996-10-21'
),
relevant_trans AS (
    SELECT t.XCL_048 AS trans_date, t.XCL_052 AS balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_account ta ON t.XCL_047 = ta.account_id
    WHERE t.XCL_048 > '1996-10-21'
      AND t.XCL_048 <= '1998-12-27'
),
first_trans AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM relevant_trans
    ORDER BY trans_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
last_trans AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM relevant_trans
    ORDER BY trans_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST((lt.balance - ft.balance) AS REAL) * 100 / ft.balance
FROM first_trans ft
CROSS JOIN last_trans lt

WITH client_info AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_009 AS client_id,
        d.XCL_015 AS account_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
    JOIN card cd ON d.XCL_013 = cd.XCL_006
    WHERE cd.XCL_008 = '1996-10-21'
),
first_trans AS (
    SELECT 
        ci.client_id,
        MIN(t.XCL_048) AS first_date
    FROM client_info ci
    JOIN trans t ON ci.account_id = t.XCL_047
    WHERE t.XCL_048 > '1996-10-21'
    GROUP BY ci.client_id
),
latest_trans AS (
    SELECT 
        ci.client_id,
        MAX(t.XCL_048) AS latest_date
    FROM client_info ci
    JOIN trans t ON ci.account_id = t.XCL_047
    WHERE t.XCL_048 <= '1998-12-27'
    GROUP BY ci.client_id
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.client_id,
        (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.XCL_049 = 'credit' THEN t.XCL_052 ELSE -t.XCL_052 END)
         FROM trans t
         WHERE t.XCL_047 = (SELECT account_id FROM client_info WHERE client_id = ft.client_id)
           AND t.XCL_048 <= ft.first_date) AS first_balance,
        (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.XCL_049 = 'credit' THEN t.XCL_052 ELSE -t.XCL_052 END)
         FROM trans t
         WHERE t.XCL_047 = (SELECT account_id FROM client_info WHERE client_id = ft.client_id)
           AND t.XCL_048 <= lt.latest_date) AS latest_balance
    FROM first_trans ft
    JOIN latest_trans lt ON ft.client_id = lt.client_id
)
SELECT 
    (latest_balance - first_balance) * 100.0 / first_balance AS percentage_increase
FROM balances
